javascript-cdn.label: JavaScript / CDN
javascript-cdn.title: JavaScript / CDN
javascript-cdn.description: Load Revo UI components with browser ES modules or a classic script. Includes CDN setup, matching styles, self-hosting and optional PDF worker configuration.

ssr.label: SSR
ssr.title: Server rendering and hydration
ssr.description: Integrate Revo UI with server-rendered React, Vue, Angular and Svelte apps. Learn client mounting, hydration boundaries, initial CSS and CSP setup.

bundle-size.label: Bundle size
bundle-size.title: Bundle size and selective styles
bundle-size.description: Keep Revo UI bundles small with tree-shaken imports, automatic or extracted CSS, selective stylesheets and reproducible size budgets.

ssr-nextjs.label: Next.js SSR
ssr-nextjs.title: Next.js App Router and Revo UI
ssr-nextjs.description: Use Revo UI in Next.js App Router with a server layout, a client page and extracted CSS. Includes a runnable SSR example and hydration checks.

ssr-nuxt.label: Nuxt SSR
ssr-nuxt.title: Nuxt and Revo UI
ssr-nuxt.description: Add Revo UI components to Nuxt with Vue state, global CSS and SSR enabled. Follow a small runnable example and verify page hydration.
ssr-nuxt.seoTitle: Nuxt SSR with Vue UI components

ssr-sveltekit.label: SvelteKit SSR
ssr-sveltekit.title: SvelteKit and Revo UI
ssr-sveltekit.description: Use named Revo UI components in SvelteKit with server-loaded data, extracted CSS and browser mounting. Includes a small runnable SSR example.

ssr-astro.label: Astro SSR
ssr-astro.title: Astro and Revo UI
ssr-astro.description: Add a Revo UI control to an Astro SSR page with a Vue island, client:load and global CSS. Follow a small runnable Node server example.
ssr-astro.seoTitle: Astro SSR with interactive Vue islands

ssr-angular.label: Angular SSR
ssr-angular.title: Angular SSR and Revo UI
ssr-angular.description: Integrate Revo UI components with Angular SSR and hydration. Use typed inputs, normal events and extracted CSS in a small runnable example.

ssr-react-router.label: React Router SSR
ssr-react-router.title: React Router and Revo UI
ssr-react-router.description: Integrate Revo UI with React Router framework-mode SSR, server loaders and extracted CSS. Includes an interactive page and verification steps.
ssr-react-router.seoTitle: React Router SSR and server loaders

ssr-tanstack-start.label: TanStack Start SSR
ssr-tanstack-start.title: TanStack Start and Revo UI
ssr-tanstack-start.description: Use Revo UI with TanStack Start SSR, server functions and extracted CSS. Build a small route with clear server and browser boundaries.

ssr-nestjs.label: NestJS
ssr-nestjs.title: NestJS and Revo UI
ssr-nestjs.description: Render a NestJS page with Handlebars and mount a Revo UI control in the browser. Includes template setup, extracted CSS and a runnable example.

integration-refine.label: Refine
integration-refine.title: Refine and Revo UI
integration-refine.description: Build a small Refine form with Next.js and Revo UI components. Follow the data-provider and mutation flow, with server rendering and validation.

integration-lovable.label: Lovable
integration-lovable.title: Lovable and Revo UI
integration-lovable.description: Add Revo UI to a Lovable project. Choose TanStack Start SSR or React/Vite, copy a simple prompt and use a component in your existing page.

presets.label: Themes and presets
presets.title: Themes and presets
presets.description: Create reusable JSON and CSS themes, customize component behavior, and share presets across projects.
